name: intro
label: Intro
default: Manage which emails you receive from Weld Australia. For your security, you may be asked to confirm your email address before your preferences load.

name: show_categories
label: Show category summary
help_text: Lists the subscription categories members can manage on the preferences page.

name: manage_link
label: Preferences page link
help_text: Link to HubSpot's Subscription Preferences system page. Defaults to /email-subscriptions/. This page must be assigned + published in HubSpot Settings → Website → Pages → System pages, or the link 404s.

name: transactional_note
label: Transactional-email note
default: Note: Unsubscribing from marketing communications does not affect transactional emails - you will always receive emails necessary to deliver services you've purchased (e.g. course confirmations, certificates, and invoices).

name: section_id
label: Section anchor ID (optional)
help_text: Used for in-page anchor links. Lower-case, hyphenated. Leave blank if not needed.

name: members_only
label: Members only
help_text: When true, this section is only rendered for logged-in active members.
